pw_slow_hash.note: Uses scrypt with a random 16-byte salt per user, at Node's default cost settings.

no_hardcoded_secret.evidence: server.js:1-119 (no signing key or secret literal)
no_hardcoded_secret.note: Tokens are random and looked up server-side, so no signing key is used. No secret literals or fallback defaults appear anywhere.

token_expiry.note: created_at is saved at line 78 but never checked. A session is only replaced when the same user logs in again (line 77).

logout_revokes.note: There is no logout endpoint, so logout is client-only. Sessions are only removed when the same user logs in again (server.js:77).

owner_checks.evidence: server.js:58 `db.notes.find(n => n.id === noteId && n.user_id === user.id)`; server.js:100-101 `const note = noteForUser(user, noteId); if (!note) return fail(res, 404...`
owner_checks.note: GET, PUT, DELETE and share (lines 102-108) all go through noteForUser, which checks the owner.

login_rate_limit.note: Failed logins are not counted, throttled or locked out.

password_policy.note: The minimum is 6 characters, so 6- and 7-character passwords are accepted.

sql_parameterized.note: There is no SQL database. Data is stored in a JSON file.

xss_safe_render.note: Titles and bodies are always escaped with esc() (line 22, covers &<>"') or set via .value. The only unescaped value is n.id, which is a server-generated hex string.

security_headers.note: No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options or X-Frame-Options header is set anywhere.
